M-CLI.NAME: CLI entry point
M-CLI.purpose: Compose the mygrace command tree and report failures through the ADR-3 error boundary.

export-main.PURPOSE: Root citty CommandDef (exported for validators/tests/MCP parity checks).

fn-guard.PURPOSE: Recursive error boundary around every command and subcommand.

fn-isDirectInvocation.PURPOSE: True only when this file is the process entry point.

export-main.PURPOSE: Registers the 20 top-level commands, including ci, trace, impact, next and projects.

contract.purpose: Compose the mygrace command tree and report failures through the ADR-3 error boundary.

param.name: exitCode
param.description: Documented exit code for every command.

error.description: Unexpected failure not wrapped by a command; printed with a debug hint.

notes.note-1: 20 top-level commands: ci, lint, module, phase, verification, file, status, install-dsh, init-dsh, doctor, test, trust, verify, packet, focus, context-cost, trace, impact, next, projects.
notes.note-2: Importing this module never executes a command, so scripts and tests can load the command tree.
notes.note-3: Every command is wrapped by guard(), so a typed error becomes one line plus its documented exit code.
